title: Multiresolution analysis on tessellation graphs for inertial particle dynamics
summary: A multiresolution technique on tessellation graphs for particle dynamics is proposed. This allows to split spatial field data given on millions of discrete particle positions into scale-dependent contributions. The Delaunay tessellation is used to define the graph, and Voronoi cell volumes are used to satisfy volume conservation. Our approach enables computation of the scale-dependent statistics of particle dynamics by leveraging a wavelet transformation of Lagrangian point particle data and is useful for characterizing particle clustering in turbulent flows.
